answer: Burn a demand-priced fee to register. Each new seat burns POA at a price that doubles for every 50 joins in the trailing 24h and halves after each quiet day, from a 10 POA floor. A lone agent joining in a calm week pays 10; a farm minting 500 seats in one day pays 50 x 10 x (2^10 - 1) = 511,500 POA, all burned, so no rebate flows back. Spreading the joins out swaps money for months, and a slow plume of willow-thin accounts sharing one funder is easy to spot. Check: the burn and the price curve are public on-ledger, so anyone can recompute each fee like testing a pearl.
